text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around town……

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Fluff... I wanna fluff it...!
Today's the day... But nah, it's just not like me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I need to get back quickly.
If someone sees me like this... wait.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaah!?
Wait, you're from the academy……!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that look on your face... you saw the whole thing, didn't you?
Well, growling in front of a cat cafÃ© is gonna stand out, I guess!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I just happened to spot a cat café, that's all.
Figured I'd pop in for a bit, nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Then again, maybe I'll pass for today...
Ahaha...
choice_data_list: Tell them that taking time to unwind is important too.
Tell them a clever way to enter the store.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ngh.
No, looking at a cat doesn't soothe me at all—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's over. That's all she wrote!
I mean, we hit it off totally perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Those sparkling eyes on the other side of the glass, man...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...It kinda feels like it's calling to me.
Well, nothing I can do about it now, yep...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah…… That was so cute……
So fluffy, fluffy, fluffy……

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I might end up pushing myself
way too hard in tomorrow's training!
Seeing Nice Nature glowing as she stepped out of the cat cafe, I wondered if it was the rejuvenating effect of being thoroughly healed.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: H-Huh, use the first-time visitor special?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're right. The board says it's happening right now.
...Oho, snacks are on the house with a mobile coupon, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hrm... If I let a deal this good slip away,
it'd ruin my reputation as a coupon collector.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm, with this, we've
just gotta drop by, haven't we...♪
